title: U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position, Q2 2026 (current account), 8:30 a.m. ET
source: EST: bea.gov/news/schedule fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200), September block reading verbatim "September 24 | 8:30 AM | News | U.S. International Transactions and Investment Position, 2nd Quarter 2026". Corroborated by bea.gov/data/intl-trade-investment/international-transactions, fetched the same session, whose header reads "Next Release: September 24, 2026" and whose last published figure is a Q1 2026 current-account deficit of $226.8 billion (released 2026-06-24, titled "...1st Quarter 2026 and Annual Update" — the ITA annual update already ran in June and is NOT part of the 09-30 national-accounts update). Filed estimate per this lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep, not on date doubt: the BEA: prefix is available but a proposal is always estimate. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: DISCOVERED during the gdp-q2-2026-third-2026-09-30 D-15 adjacency sweep (2026-09-15), on the proposing lane's own primary re-fetch of BEA's release schedule, and proposed because it is the one pre-release read on this revision's most-cited channel. The Q1 2026 GDP third estimate revised real GDP up 0.5pp (1.6% -> 2.1%) "primarily reflecting a downward revision to imports" — net exports are where recent third-estimate surprises have come from, and the Q2 current account published six days earlier runs off the same Q2 source data that feeds the 09-30 vintage. It was untracked, which left that channel invisible to a corridor otherwise carrying 49 ids. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same grounds as the sibling BEA entries: no macro-keyed house playbook attaches, no instrument runs, and the release has no measured tape signal of its own next to the 09-30 stack. Note the ITA annual update ran with the 06-24 release, so this print is NOT a preview of the 09-30 national-accounts rewrite — it is a source-data read, and conflating the two would be the mistake this note exists to prevent. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
